entry.title: Plan obligation: demonstrate the SDP construction and primal/dual consistency at n=1 (support, not an original proof).
entry.subtitle: wiesner_noisy · A. Molina, T. Vidick, J. Watrous. Optimal counterfeiting attacks and generalizations for Wiesner's quantum money. TQC 2012, LNCS 7582, 45-64. arXiv:1202.4010v1

fields.label: Source and theorem
fields.text: Plan obligation: demonstrate the SDP construction and primal/dual consistency at n=1 (support, not an original proof). MVW2012 Sec. 2.3-3.2 SDP (Choi primal max <G,J>, J>=0, Tr_out J=1; dual min Tr Y, Y(x)1>=G). NO published closed-form bound for the noisy/threshold W2 game itself.

fields.label: Assumptions
items: SDP support is for the finite-dimensional ideal game W1 (n=1,2) and W1_CV (n=1) as constructed by lane C (audits/SDP_DERIVATION.md, input-first big-endian Choi ordering).
W2 (per-copy threshold, noise, loss) is not covered by any certificate yet.

fields.label: Finite n or asymptotic
fields.text: exact finite n (n=1,2 for W1; n=1 for W1_CV)

fields.label: Quantifier over adversaries
fields.text: every CPTP 1->2 map (W1) / every challenge-dependent POVM (W1_CV), via weak duality of an exactly verified dual

fields.label: Numerical method
fields.text: lane C: CVXPY (SCS/Clarabel) dual -> dyadic rounding -> delta*1 shift -> exact Fraction LDL^T positive-definiteness

fields.label: Verification script
fields.text: lane C: qmint/attacks/certify.py, coherent_sdp.py; evidence handoffs/C-C1-evidence.json (main @ c9f0ec0)

fields.label: Independent crosscheck
fields.text: lane D: qmint/proofs/sdp_exact.py via checker.py (separate code path, imports nothing from qmint.attacks): own exact G_n from rational BB84 projectors, own exact PSD test (pivoting Gaussian elimination valid for singular matrices), own duals. Verified EXACTLY: Y=(3/8)^n 1 satisfies Y(x)1 - G_n >= 0 for n=1,2 (=> OPT_n <= 3/4, 9/16); W1_CV n=1 own dyadic dual gives OPT <= 127375219105/137438953472 = 0.92677669530531. Every lane C certified upper bound (SCS and Clarabel, n=1,2; W1_CV n=1) is >= these, so each claim is CONFIRMED; residual accounting (bound >= dual + delta*dim) consistent for all W1 records (tests/unit/proofs/test_checker.py).

fields.label: Caveats
items: Applying (3/4)^n to W2 is refused (tested); CERTIFIED_NUMERIC certificates for game W2 are refused by the checker (no independent G construction for W2 exists).

Lane C did not export its rational dual matrices Y, so lane D confirmed the CLAIMED BOUND VALUES (claim >= independently verified bound), not C's specific matrices. The checker can verify an explicit rational Y (parameters.sdp_certificate.dual_matrix_rational) when supplied; proposal: C exports Y as fraction strings.
Lane C's W1_CV record has no delta_shift field; residual accounting for it was checked with delta = (certified - dual)/8.
Exact verification is limited to Choi dimension <= 64 (W1 n <= 2).

MVW2012 Sec. 3.5 threshold result (binomial tail in the single-repetition optimum) counts JOINT both-copies successes per repetition; it is not a per-copy threshold verifier and does not cover W2 (agrees with lane A seed T-MVW12-SEC35 and lane C negative control). Not implemented: would need a new game id (lane A proposal W1_THRESH_JOINT).

fields.label: Reproduced examples
items: W1_CV n=1 independent exact dual bound 0.92677669530531 (theorem 0.92677669529664); confirms lane C 0.9267766955417756
